Six commits on lane/conduct-discovery-final-tests-20260906, Grok-only trailers, HEAD 75aa9a4395b72103256c7b962a6f78f898395c17, working tree clean.

Row coverage is 53/53 named D-A IDs (D-A1..D-A49 plus D-A17b, D-A17c, D-A38b, D-A38c) across 56 methods. Extra methods are the presence checks and the five/seven law equality gate. Document tables measured equal: discovery five pairs match onboard's first five; onboard has seven. constraint_only_lock is 399 bytes and names symfony/workflow only outside packages[].name.

Claude's thirteen findings are applied in the tests: D-A8 mapping locked is null; D-A47 does not require the contract digest in the closed Source object; D-A16 is a 17-ID readable supersedes chain with a stale first page and a globally current terminal key; D-A38 requires the initial work drop and the 8192 cap with no optional branch; D-A38c pads recorded_status from an independent envelope model; D-A43 pins selection one; D-A46 plants a failed retained source; D-A34 plants a constraint canary; D-A39/D-A44 compare canonical/raw bytes; D-A28 uses chmod-0 or a FIFO so listdir fails as root; the live-repo git-diff custody guard is gone; vacuous asserts were removed. D-A31 calls ops.conductor.tools.lane_refs.acquire(config, boot, checkpoint=...) with synchronous retained-ref and dispatch-file mutation, a stationary neighbor, failed-before-phase omission, and an omitted-check control that would accept a success packet. No sleeps. D-A47 uses --discovery-boot-fd, missing and rejected boot lines, A/A and B/B markers, A/B binding-mismatch, digest-only fault control, and in-process loader custody of the dotted acquire target. D-A48 missing HEAD yields evidence ["contract"]; a verified HEAD plus corrupt mapping blob yields ["contract","repo"].

Red per file, then combined, all AssertionError, 0 errors: config 10/10, startup 11/14, catalogues 7/10, handoffs 14/14, snapshots 6/6, adapter 8/8; combined `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p test_discovery_v3_*.py` at 75aa9a4 Ran 56 tests in 8.776s FAILED (failures=62).
